item.title: This Weekend in Rhode Island: Comic Con, The Great Gatsby and WaterFire for Veterans
item.description: Comic Con fills the Convention Center, The Great Gatsby plays PPAC, WaterFire honors veterans Saturday night, and church bazaars open the holiday shopping season, Nov. 6 to 8.

item.title: Rhode Island Today and Tonight: Gatsby, Stargazing and Almost, Maine
item.description: Friday, Nov. 6: The Great Gatsby at 7:30 PM at PPAC, Stargazing Nights at Frosty Drew from 7 PM and Almost, Maine at 7:30 PM in West Warwick.

item.title: Stargazing Fridays at Frosty Drew Observatory in Charlestown
item.description: Every Friday, weather permitting, from 7:00 to 10:00 PM at 62 Park Lane in Ninigret Park, Charlestown; adults $5 and children under 5 at no charge.

item.title: Thanksgiving in Rhode Island: The 2026 Guide
item.description: Turkey trots, community meals, places to volunteer, Thanksgiving Masses and about 30 restaurants serving dinner on Thursday, Nov. 26.

item.title: Ringing In 2027: Rhode Island's New Year's Eve Guide
item.description: Noon countdowns, Providence's riverfront fireworks, tasting dinners, black-tie balls, live bands and comedy across the state on Thursday, Dec. 31.

item.title: Rhode Island's 2026 Christmas Season Events Guide
item.description: Dates, times and prices for Trinity Rep, Cirque du Soleil, the Boston Pops, The Nutcracker, the Newport mansions, tree lightings and light displays statewide.

item.title: Almost, Maine Brings Northern Lights Romance to West Warwick
item.description: Evening shows at 7:30 p.m. and Sunday matinees at 2 p.m. through Nov. 22 at The Arctic Playhouse in West Warwick.

item.title: Newport Classical's November Nights: a Piano Debut and Guitar
item.description: Fridays, Nov. 6 and Nov. 20, at 7:30 p.m. at Newport Classical Recital Hall, 42 Dearborn Street, in Newport.

item.title: Blithewold's Expressions of Nature Reception and Fall Family Days
item.description: Family programs on Saturday, Nov. 7 and an Expressions of Nature reception on Sunday, Nov. 15, 1 to 3 p.m., at Blithewold in Bristol.

item.title: Providence Singers Sing American Voices in Warren and Providence
item.description: Saturday, Nov. 21 at 7:00 p.m. at St. Mary of the Bay in Warren, and Sunday, Nov. 22 at 3:00 p.m. at Central Congregational Church in Providence.

item.title: Holiday Premiere: Handmade Gifts at WaterFire Arts Center, Nov. 15
item.description: Sunday, Nov. 15 from 10:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m. at 475 Valley Street in Providence, with no-charge admission.

item.title: Providence Winter Farmers Market Opens Its Season Saturday, Nov. 7
item.description: Saturday, Nov. 7 from 9:00 a.m. to 1:00 p.m. at 10 Sims Avenue in Providence, with local farm and food vendors under one roof.

item.title: Ballet RI's In Motion Comes to Westerly's United Theatre, Nov. 6
item.description: Friday, November 6 at 7:30 p.m. at the United Theatre in Westerly, with three works including a company premiere.

item.title: Chorus of Westerly Rings In the Season With Vaughan Williams' Hodie
item.description: Saturday, November 14 at 6 p.m. and Sunday, November 15 at 3 p.m. at George Kent Performance Hall in Westerly.

item.title: Rhode Island Comic Con Takes Over Providence, Nov. 6–8
item.description: Friday through Sunday at the Rhode Island Convention Center and Amica Mutual Pavilion, with the Sunday session starting at 10 a.m.

item.title: Newport Classical's Holiday Concerts Bring Choral Music to December
item.description: Christmas with Cantus, Messiah at the Mansion and Classical Christmas with Frisson on Dec. 5, 6 and 12, with early-afternoon showtimes in Newport.

item.title: Trinity Rep Marks 50 Years of A Christmas Carol
item.description: The Providence company's golden-anniversary production, directed by Taavon Gamble, plays Nov. 5 through Dec. 31 in the Dowling Theater.

item.title: Ballet RI's Nutcracker Returns to The VETS, Dec. 17-27
item.description: Yury Yanowsky's production of Tchaikovsky's holiday ballet plays seven days at the Veterans Memorial Auditorium in Providence.

item.title: Handel's Messiah with the RI Philharmonic and Providence Singers
item.description: A family-friendly Sunday matinee on Dec. 13, 3 p.m., at The VETS in Providence, with tickets from $25.

item.title: Angel Otero's Layered Atlantic at the Newport Art Museum
item.description: "The Ocean Forgot Your Garden" is on view through Jan. 10, 2027, at 76 Bellevue Avenue, Newport.

item.title: The Great Gatsby Musical Roars Into PPAC, Nov. 3–8
item.description: The Tony-winning Broadway musical brings the Roaring Twenties to downtown Providence for eight performances.

item.title: November's Big Shows: Dave Matthews, Jeff Tweedy, Marty Stuart and More
item.description: From an arena night at the AMP to a Wilco frontman at the Uptown, here are the concerts worth circling this month.

item.title: WaterFire's Salute to Veterans Lights Up Providence Nov. 7
item.description: 150 veterans carry torches into WaterPlace Park for the 14th annual tribute, with a veterans resource fair and a ceremony at the State House.

item.title: Jay Leno Brings His Stand-Up to the Stadium Theatre Nov. 6
item.description: The former Tonight Show host plays Woonsocket's Monument Square on Friday, Nov. 6 at 8 p.m., with the Jack Babineau Band opening.

item.title: Country Hall of Famer Marty Stuart Plays the Park Theatre Nov. 8
item.description: Marty Stuart and His Fabulous Superlatives bring their instrumental album 'Space Junk' to Cranston on Sunday, Nov. 8 at 7 p.m.

item.title: RI Philharmonic Plays 'Ride of the Valkyries!' at The VETS
item.description: Wagner, Clara Schumann's Piano Concerto, Dvorak and Ravel's La Valse, Saturday, Nov. 21 at 7:30 p.m. Tickets start at $25.

item.title: Rhode Island's Holiday Shows: Scrooge's 50th, Cirque du Soleil and Disney On Ice
item.description: Trinity Rep celebrates 50 years of A Christmas Carol, Cirque makes its PPAC debut, and the Boston Pops come to town.
